status: research-only; inactive proposal; no live gameplay

environment.execution: Node standard libraries only; no browser/server

singleCandidate.notParent: Grow18; its hazard-classification change is not included here
singleCandidate.exactAddedStatement: if (cappedGame && o.geometryAccepted === 0 && finite(o.visualR) && o.visualR > 0) upper = Math.max(upper, (o.visualR + 6) / .808);
singleCandidate.insertion: before clipped expansion and original v2.22 upper cap
singleCandidate.policyScope: v2.22, all HUD stages, geometryAccepted exactly 0 only
singleCandidate.rationale: Prevent a rejected metric geometry estimate from automatically inheriting a narrow outline-based error band.

constants.paddingReason: two step-3 component cells in the frozen 2000-wide capture at ratio1; deliberately chosen heuristic allowance, not an occlusion or anti-aliasing proof

singleCandidate.expectedTradeoff: Fewer false meals and a larger uncertain hazard envelope, but some truly edible large-outline or partially occluded NPCs are excluded; live growth and survival can both worsen.
singleCandidate.acceptance: Synthetic results establish behavior only; any live test needs a separately frozen protocol and full native outcomes.

mechanics.idealOutlineDerivation: At angles0 and pi both vertices use1.01*wobble. Their sin3a/cos5a terms cancel in the left-right span; halfSpan=1.01*wobble*R>=.808R. The full unoccluded continuous polygon bbox radius V is at least this halfSpan, hence R<=V/.808 under that condition.
mechanics.interpretation: The existing visualR*.88 floor is not a physical-radius upper bound. The proposed floor is an uncertainty policy informed by the complete-outline relation, not a universally certified bound.
mechanics.observabilityLimit: clipped checks canvas/UI boundaries only. labelSeen, localReliable density/aspect and component connectivity do not certify an unoccluded body or complete circumference. An occluded compact region can still pass them.
mechanics.tracking: The previous-object match uses estimated r tolerance max(6,.2r), class and a100-unit position gate. stalled requires that match, unchanged integer HUD and d<.74*(HUD+r); blocked is only stalled>.5 and has no persistent cooldown.

historicalContext.interpretation: Prediction/outcome disagreement motivates research, but the numeric log lacks x/y, stalled/blocked, full objects and stable identity; it does not prove a specific false meal or death cause.

limits: Synthetic fixtures use the frozen circular-body test generator and a synthetic label, not exact browser rasterization of the game polygon/font/anti-aliasing.
Missing and half highlights model ambiguous visibility; they do not establish that an identical composite image occurred in a recorded game.
Fixture physical radii label synthetic expected outcomes only. They are never passed to either planner; controller inputs are derived pixel estimates and the supplied visible HUD.
The selected synthetic body is placed at a fixed visible relative distance260 for planner isolation, not reconstructed from a real screenshot.
No recorded images, full object frames or stable target identities are available in the historical numeric logs. Those logs cannot prove a specific culprit NPC or replay its classification.
The6-unit padding is fixed to the frozen capture/ratio assumptions and is not a universal sampling bound. It must not be silently reused at another ratio.
Occlusion and merged/split components can defeat any radius bound derived from the current bounding box alone. This proposal does not solve that observability limit.
The original soft-hazard treatment of a capped radius200 at HUD180..185 remains in this isolated proposal. It is not a substitute for the separate Grow18 hypothesis.
The tracker limitations are measured but not changed. Adding a blocked TTL alone would not fix radius-gated identity loss or repeated boundary jitter.
No win-rate, safety, precision or formal OCR4 improvement is demonstrated; no live game, server, browser, archive or GitHub mutation was performed.
